description: This file defines the CollapsibleTitleNode class for a rich text editor, including methods for DOM conversion, JSON serialization, and node manipulation within a collapsible UI component.

classes.name: CollapsibleTitleNode
classes.description: A custom element node representing the title of a collapsible section, with methods for DOM creation, JSON serialization, and node insertion.

methods.name: convertSummaryElement
methods.description: Converts a summary element into a CollapsibleTitleNode.

methods.name: $createCollapsibleTitleNode
methods.description: Factory function to create a new CollapsibleTitleNode with optional formatting.

methods.name: $isCollapsibleTitleNode
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a CollapsibleTitleNode.
